notes_for_editor: Story withheld. The only text about this peak is WillhiteWeb's guess, marked Likely, plus a listing among sites the author has not visited. That does not reach the 120-word floor without padding, and it does not confirm that a lookout ever stood here. The Nothing known. line on the WillhiteWeb page belongs to Mount Terrill, not Lake Fork Mountain; one search summary misattributed it. The Ashley National Forest history page (fs.usda.gov/r04/ashley/recreation/discover-history) lists the Ute Mountain tower and guard stations and names no Lake Fork lookout. The GNIS summit table (local data/sources/peaks_gnis.json) places Lake Fork Mountain at 40.57682, -110.45491, about 0.6 km from the record's point. A search summary mentioned a Lake Fork Guard Station in Idaho; it was not read and is not used. Next step: Ashley National Forest historic-site staff or the Utah State Historic Preservation Office.
